es: Usar bloques léxicos frecuentes del habla (the thing is, to be fair, mind you, come to think of it, for what it's worth…) para dar fluidez, con gerundio e infinitivo correctos.

usesVocabulary: to cut a long story short

vocabulary.en: to cut a long story short

teaching.en: Apparently, the landlord is selling the building; the thing is, nobody has told the tenants anything yet.
teaching.es: Por lo visto, el casero vende el edificio; la cuestión es que nadie les ha dicho nada a los inquilinos todavía.
teaching.explanationEs: Apparently cuenta lo que has oído; the thing is presenta el problema y va seguido de una frase completa.
segments: Apparently, the landlord is selling the building; the thing
is, nobody has told the tenants anything yet.
teaching.audioText: Apparently, the landlord is selling the building; the thing is, nobody has told the tenants anything yet.

teaching.en: Basically, she forgot to book the venue; to be fair, nobody reminded her, and to be honest, I forgot too.
teaching.es: Básicamente, olvidó reservar el local; siendo justos, nadie se lo recordó, y para ser sincero, yo también me olvidé.
teaching.explanationEs: Forget + to + verbo: no hacer algo pendiente. To be fair concede; to be honest admite.
segments: Basically, she forgot to book the venue; to be fair,
nobody reminded her, and to be honest, I forgot too.
teaching.audioText: Basically, she forgot to book the venue; to be fair, nobody reminded her, and to be honest, I forgot too.

teaching.en: Anyway, it's not like I mind helping, but come to think of it, I spent all of last weekend moving boxes.
teaching.es: En fin, no es que me importe ayudar, pero ahora que lo pienso, pasé todo el fin de semana pasado moviendo cajas.
teaching.explanationEs: Mind + gerundio (mind helping). Come to think of it introduce una idea que se recuerda de repente.
segments: Anyway, it's not like I mind helping, but come to think
of it, I spent all of last weekend moving boxes.
teaching.audioText: Anyway, it's not like I mind helping, but come to think of it, I spent all of last weekend moving boxes.

teaching.en: She stopped talking to me straight afterwards; mind you, she had apologised twice, as a matter of fact, so basically we are fine.
teaching.es: Dejó de hablarme justo después; eso sí, se había disculpado dos veces, de hecho, así que básicamente estamos bien.
teaching.explanationEs: Stop + gerundio = dejar de hacer algo; stop + to + verbo = pararse para hacerlo. As a matter of fact refuerza un dato.
segments: She stopped talking to me straight afterwards; mind you, she had apologised
twice, as a matter of fact, so basically we are fine.
teaching.audioText: She stopped talking to me straight afterwards; mind you, she had apologised twice, as a matter of fact, so basically we are fine.

teaching.en: To cut a long story short, he apologised, and for what it's worth, I believed him; anyway, that is all in the past.
teaching.es: Resumiendo, se disculpó, y por si sirve de algo, le creí; en fin, todo eso ya es pasado.
teaching.explanationEs: To cut a long story short resume; for what it's worth ofrece una opinión con modestia.
segments: To cut a long story short, he apologised, and for what it's
worth, I believed him; anyway, that is all in the past.
teaching.audioText: To cut a long story short, he apologised, and for what it's worth, I believed him; anyway, that is all in the past.

teaching.en: Basically, chunks buy you thinking time; use them sparingly, or you may sound vague rather than fluent.
teaching.es: Básicamente, los bloques te dan tiempo para pensar; úsalos con moderación, o podrías sonar vago en lugar de fluido.
teaching.explanationEs: Un bloque debe ayudar a hablar con claridad, no llenar silencios sin sentido.
segments: Basically, chunks buy you thinking time; use them sparingly,
or you may sound vague rather than fluent.

prompt.es: Completa: «Siendo justos, ella intentó llamarte dos veces.»

feedback.es: To be fair concede un punto a favor de alguien antes de seguir.

hint.es: Adjetivo de «justo» dentro del bloque que concede algo.

origin.text: You are upset that your sister missed your party. Your brother says: To be ___, she did try to call you twice, and she was stuck at work.

choices.text: Mind you, I should get back to work.
Basically, I should get back to work.
Anyway, I should get back to work.

feedback.es: Anyway corta el tema anterior y permite pasar a otra cosa; mind you y basically no sirven para despedirse.

hint.es: Busca el bloque que cierra o cambia de tema.

origin.text: Leo and Mia have talked about the holiday for twenty minutes, and there is nothing more to say. Mia looks at her watch and wants to get back to her desk.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La cuestión es que olvidé reservar la mesa.»

answer.text: The thing is, I forgot to book the table

feedback.es: The thing is abre el problema y forget + to + verbo dice qué no se hizo.

hint.es: Empieza con el bloque que presenta el problema.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué actitud muestra la hablante ante el cierre de la tienda.

choices.text: She is not surprised and feels little sense of loss.
She is not surprised, but she regrets that the shop never had customers.
She is surprised by the news, though she never liked the prices.

feedback.es: Dice que no le sorprende, que nunca vio clientes y que no echará de menos los precios: es indiferente, no lamenta la falta de clientes ni se sorprende.

origin.audio: Apparently, the shop is closing down. Mind you, I am not surprised; to be honest, I never saw more than two customers in there. Anyway, it's not like I will miss the prices.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada bloque con su función en la conversación.

pairs.es: Conceder algo a favor del otro
Añadir un matiz a lo dicho

feedback.es: Cada bloque cumple una función distinta: problema, concesión, matiz y recuerdo repentino.

pairs.es: Conceder algo a favor del otro
Añadir un matiz a lo dicho

prompt.es: Completa: «Recuerdo haber cerrado la ventana antes de salir.»

feedback.es: Remember + gerundio recuerda algo que ya se hizo; remember + to sería algo pendiente.

origin.text: It cannot have been me who left the window open. I remember ___ it before I left the house, and I checked it twice.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué sugiere el hablante sobre las excusas de su hermano.

choices.text: He accepts the excuses and is glad that his brother will visit on Sunday.
He grants a few points but expects his brother to let Gran down again.
He thinks his brother forgot because he is too busy with work.

feedback.es: Concede algún punto (to be fair), pero señala que pasó un día entero sin llamada y que la promesa viene de alguien que ya olvidó una en marzo: espera que vuelva a fallarle a la abuela.

origin.audio: I asked my brother whether he had called Gran on her birthday. Well, apparently, the thing is, his phone had no battery, and, to be fair, he was stuck on the motorway for three hours. Mind you, it was four o'clock when I asked him, and the birthday was yesterday. Come to think of it, he did say in March that he would remember to call her. Anyway, for what it's worth, he has now promised to drive over on Sunday. To cut a long story short, Gran has waited a whole day for that call, and I suspect she will be waiting on Sunday as well.

prompt.es: Completa: «Básicamente, terminé casi todo, pero falta revisar las cifras.»

feedback.es: Basically resume lo esencial antes de dar el detalle que falta.

origin.text: Did you finish the report? ___, I did most of it, but I still need to check the figures before I send it.

prompt.es: ¿Para qué dice Sara «to be fair» en esta conversación?

choices.text: To warn Leo that the manager will reject his next plan too.
To excuse the manager completely and tell Leo to drop the matter.
To soften Leo's complaint with a point in the manager's favour.

feedback.es: To be fair introduce un dato favorable a la directora que matiza la queja de Leo sin negarla; Sara no la excusa del todo ni pide que lo deje.

origin.text: Leo spent the coffee break complaining about the new manager, who had rejected his plan without a word of thanks. Sara listened, then said quietly: «To be fair, she has been here three weeks and she has a budget problem.» Leo looked at his cup and said that, actually, it was only a plan.

prompt.es: Explica a Tom por qué faltaste a su fiesta usando bloques del habla.

answer.text: The thing is, I was feeling ill, and to be honest, I forgot to call you. Anyway, I am sorry, and for what it's worth, I would love to see you this weekend.
accepted: The thing is, I was feeling ill, and to be honest, I forgot to call you. Anyway, I am sorry, and for what it's worth, I would love to see you this weekend.
The thing is, I was exhausted after work. To be honest, I should have called you. Anyway, let's meet on Saturday; for what it's worth, I will bring the cake.

feedback.es: Una buena respuesta usa tres bloques: The thing is para el problema, to be honest para admitir y anyway para cerrar.

origin.text: Tom te pregunta por qué no fuiste a su fiesta. Respóndele con tres bloques: The thing is…, To be honest… y Anyway… (o for what it's worth…).

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender el hablante sobre su relación con ella?

choices.text: He cares about her but is frustrated that she hides problems.
He is annoyed that she is always too busy to talk to him.
He admits that he hides problems too, and he blames himself.

feedback.es: Niega que le caiga mal, le frustra que ella oculte sus problemas y reconoce que él hace lo mismo: hay cariño y reproche, no autoinculpación total ni enojo por falta de tiempo.

origin.text: «It's not like I dislike her,» he said, stirring his tea for the third time. «The thing is, she always says she's fine, and then I find out a week later that she wasn't. Mind you, I'm no better. I do exactly the same thing with my own problems, and then I wonder why nobody tells me anything.»

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para ser sincero, dejé de comer azúcar el año pasado.»

answer.text: To be honest, I stopped eating sugar last year
accepted: To be honest, I stopped eating sugar last year
I stopped eating sugar last year, to be honest

feedback.es: Stop + gerundio significa dejar de hacer algo, y to be honest introduce una opinión sincera.

prompt.es: Completa: «Olvidó pagar la factura, así que le cortaron la luz.»

feedback.es: Forget + to + verbo significa olvidar hacer algo pendiente, como pagar la factura.

origin.text: Sara is usually very careful with money. This time she forgot ___ the bill, so the power was cut off for two days.
